description: Exploratory T1 CRISPRi core plus seven usable KO bank units, twelve contexts and five study-lineage votes. KO effects versus matched controls, no panel centering, fixed 0.25 study weight and within-study reliability pooling. CRISPRi estimator, amplitude, cis and t36 generator unchanged. All 34 KO-supported panel targets used. CRISPRa and unresolved-source gaps remain explicit; no prior improvement or complete D-053 claim. 6722 KO-only target-gene pairs retain the full normalized KO estimate.
